theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, 0 < Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))) ∧ ∀ S : Set (Rn n), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((fun v => graphPoint v (P v)) '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) * (volume : Measure (Rn n)) S
